verdict.rationale: The evidence covers single-request routing, fallbacks, streaming, key management, and privacy controls, but nothing describes a bulk/batch API or mechanism for submitting many items in one operation (e.g. batch completions, bulk model queries, or bulk key/workspace operations). Missing for 10: a documented batch/bulk endpoint or workflow for processing many items in a single call, evidence of bulk data import/export, and any hands-on confirmation of bulk usage.
